note: Curated public copy only: the words a person has to choose. The site's name, repository, namespace, licence, versions, counts and digests are read from config/project.yaml, the pins and the ontology at build time, because a figure typed here is a second description that can drift from the first.
tagline: A realist ontology aligned to BFO 2020 and CCO v2.0

draft.text: Draft. Nothing on this site is a release until a version is tagged; see Releases.
draft.why: A reader landing on any page should know whether what they see is settled. Set show to false once releases are the normal state.

iri_resolution.why: When IRIs do not resolve over HTTP, rendering them as links sends a reader to a 404 and implies the ontology is broken; the footer says so and IRIs are copyable text. Set resolve to true once they do.

acknowledgment.why: Who besides the licence holder made this, and how -- including substantive assistance from AI agents. Empty prints only the licence holder.

build_label.why: A Pages build is not a release. The source commit is shown beside this label.

for_reviewers: Explore the terms: every authored term beside the BFO and CCO terms it builds on, each marked authored or upstream.
Read the competency questions: what the ontology must be able to answer, and whether it does.
Check the status page for the decisions recorded, what the validation gate finds, and what is not done.
